mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment supports valuation expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent 1.0% monthly increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 1.0% month-over-month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 1.0% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a 0.5% monthly decline in industrial production signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profit visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 0.5% month-over-month during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate (below 5.0%) indicates tight labor market conditions that support corporate wage growth and earnings expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.0% signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent 0.5% monthly declines in industrial production and housing starts indicate broad-based economic contraction that triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both fall > 0.5% month-over-month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST fall > 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a 1.0% monthly decline in retail sales signals weakening consumer spending that reduces near-term earnings visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS falls > 1.0% month-over-month and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
